procedure: The coordinator separately observed the prior recovery checkout clean, fetched the handoff branch, checked FETCH_HEAD, checked it out detached, separately observed the stated commit and clean status, ran the full public evidence driver, and observed the same commit and clean status again.
prepublish_byte_equality: The complete recovery transcript equals the separately captured prepublish transcript byte for byte.
qualification: The transcript itself does not embed checkout identity; the coordinator observed it separately. Fetch, checkout, verification and retained originals are on the same machine and do not establish independent-machine custody, complete privacy or product behavior.
